name: QOwnNotes
summary: Plain-text Markdown notepad with Nextcloud Notes support

config.notes: On Linux the settings are the Qt INI file ~/.config/PBE/QOwnNotes.conf and they record the absolute path of the note folder; the Windows build keeps the same settings elsewhere, so they are set aside rather than restored in place. The notes themselves are plain Markdown files in a folder the user chose.
